Show current tmux window status options

The running tmux session has extra status-bar settings not in your dotfiles config. I'll add the full status-bar configuration there.

input.old_string:
set -g status-position bottom

input.new_string:
set -g status-position top
set -g status-style 'bg=#181825,fg=#cdd6f4'
set -g status-left ''
set -g status-left-length 0
set -g status-left-style 'bg=#181825,fg=#cdd6f4'
set -g status-right '%H:%M %d-%b-%y'
set -g status-right-length 40
set -g status-right-style 'bg=#181825,fg=#cdd6f4'

# Window list on the status bar: no session name, flags, or pane title
set -g window-status-format ' #I:#W '
set -g window-status-current-format ' #I:#W '
set -g window-status-style 'fg=#6c7086'
set -g window-status-current-style 'bg=#45475a,fg=#cdd6f4,bold'
set -g window-status-separator ''

input.description: Reload tmux config and verify options

input.command: tmux show-options -g window-status-format window-status-current-format window-status-current-style window-status-style window-status-separator
tmux show -g window-status-format; tmux show -g window-status-current-format; tmux show -g window-status-current-style; tmux show -g window-status-separator

content.text:
Updated `dotfiles/.tmux.conf` (symlinked from `~/.tmux.conf`) and reloaded it in your running tmux session. Changes:

| Setting | Change |
|---|---|
| **Bar position** | Moved to the top |
| **Active window** | Rectangle background (`#45475a`) with bold text |
| **`[sots]`** | Removed by clearing `status-left` |
| **Description** | Removed the quoted pane title from `status-right` |
| **`*` / `-` suffixes** | Removed by dropping `#{window_flags}` from window formats |

The status bar now shows only the window list (with the active one highlighted) on the left area, and time/date on the right.

New sessions pick this up automatically. For any existing tmux server that did not reload, run:

```bash
tmux source-file ~/.tmux.conf
```

If you want window names without the `0:`, `1:` index prefix, I can strip that too.
